words.enDefinition: an undergraduate university degree usually completed in four years

examples.en: After four years of hard work, she finally earned her bachelor's degree in economics.
examples.zh: 经过四年努力，她终于拿到了经济学「学士学位」。

examples.en: The graduation office confirmed my bachelor's degree will be conferred this May.
examples.zh: 毕业办公室确认我的「学士学位」将在今年五月正式授予。

words.enDefinition: a first degree in humanities or social science subjects

examples.en: My brother will graduate with a bachelor of arts in history next spring.
examples.zh: 我哥哥明年春季将以历史学「文学学士」毕业。

examples.en: The diploma reads Bachelor of Arts, but everyone just calls it a BA.
examples.zh: 证书上印着「文学学士」，不过大家都简称 BA。

collocations: a bachelor of arts in history

words.enDefinition: a first degree in science or technical subjects

examples.en: She is completing a bachelor of science in computer science this semester.
examples.zh: 她这学期就要读完计算机科学的「理学学士」。

examples.en: A bachelor of science usually requires more lab courses than a BA.
examples.zh: 和文学学士相比，「理学学士」通常要求更多实验课。

collocations: a bachelor of science in nursing

words.enDefinition: a first university degree taken before graduate study

examples.en: International students often need an undergraduate degree before applying to master's programs.
examples.zh: 国际学生通常要先取得「本科学位」才能申请硕士项目。

examples.en: He finished his undergraduate degree in three years by taking summer courses.
examples.zh: 他通过修暑期课程，三年就拿完了「本科学位」。

words.enDefinition: a two-year degree typically earned at a community college

examples.en: She earned an associate degree at a community college before transferring here.
examples.zh: 转来这里之前，她在社区学院拿了「副学士学位」。

examples.en: Many associate degree credits transfer toward a four-year bachelor's program.
examples.zh: 很多「副学士学位」的学分可以转入四年制本科项目。

collocations: an associate degree in liberal arts

words.enDefinition: a graduate degree pursued after finishing a bachelor's

examples.en: He plans to pursue a master's degree in data science after graduation.
examples.zh: 他打算毕业后继续攻读数据科学「硕士学位」。

examples.en: A master's degree usually takes one or two years of full-time study.
examples.zh: 「硕士学位」通常需要一到两年的全日制学习。

collocations: a master's degree in data science

words.enDefinition: the highest university degree based on original research

examples.en: Earning a doctoral degree took her six years of coursework and research.
examples.zh: 拿到「博士学位」花了她六年时间的课程和科研。

examples.en: Only students with a doctoral degree can supervise dissertations in most departments.
examples.zh: 在大多数院系，只有持「博士学位」的人才能指导博士论文。

words.enDefinition: a doctoral course of study with coursework and dissertation research

examples.en: She was admitted to the PhD program in chemistry starting this fall.
examples.zh: 她被今年秋季入学的化学「博士项目」录取了。

examples.en: Applying to a PhD program usually requires reference letters and a statement of purpose.
examples.zh: 申请「博士项目」通常需要推荐信和目的陈述。

collocations: be admitted to a PhD program

words.enDefinition: a special track of advanced courses for high-achieving undergraduates

examples.en: Students in the honors program take smaller, more demanding seminar courses.
examples.zh: 「荣誉项目」的学生上的是人数更少、要求更高的研讨课。

examples.en: Joining the honors program requires a high GPA and an application essay.
examples.zh: 加入「荣誉项目」需要很高的绩点和一篇申请短文。

words.enDefinition: a separate on-campus college for top undergraduate students

examples.en: The honors college offers priority registration and dedicated advising for members.
examples.zh: 「荣誉学院」为成员提供优先选课和专属指导。

examples.en: She moved into the honors college dorm in her sophomore year.
examples.zh: 她大二时搬进了「荣誉学院」的宿舍。

collocations: be admitted to the honors college

words.enDefinition: graduation honors with Latin names awarded by GPA tier

examples.en: She graduated with Latin honors, which appear on her diploma and transcript.
examples.zh: 她以「拉丁荣誉等级」毕业，这一荣誉印在证书和成绩单上。

examples.en: Each school sets GPA cutoffs for the three levels of Latin honors.
examples.zh: 每个学校都为「拉丁荣誉等级」的三档设定了绩点门槛。

words.enDefinition: the first Latin honor, awarded for solid academic performance

examples.en: She made her parents proud by graduating cum laude from business school.
examples.zh: 她以「优等毕业荣誉」从商学院毕业，让父母非常自豪。

examples.en: Cum laude is the first of the three Latin honors at graduation.
examples.zh: 「优等毕业荣誉」是毕业时三档拉丁荣誉中的第一档。

words.enDefinition: the middle Latin honor, above cum laude for higher GPAs

examples.en: His 3.8 GPA qualified him for magna cum laude at commencement.
examples.zh: 他 3.8 的绩点使他够格获得「极优等毕业荣誉」。

examples.en: Magna cum laude is printed on the diploma below the degree name.
examples.zh: 「极优等毕业荣誉」会印在证书上学位名称的下方。

words.enDefinition: the highest Latin honor for near-perfect academic records

examples.en: Only a handful of graduates receive summa cum laude each year.
examples.zh: 每年只有极少数毕业生能获得「最优等毕业荣誉」。

examples.en: She finished first in her class and earned summa cum laude honors.
examples.zh: 她以全班第一的成绩获得了「最优等毕业荣誉」。

words.enDefinition: the British system ranking final degrees into classes

examples.en: UK universities announce your degree classification based on final-year marks.
examples.zh: 英国大学会根据毕业年级的成绩公布你的「学位等级」。

examples.en: A first is the highest degree classification most employers look for.
examples.zh: 一等是大多数雇主最看重的「学位等级」。

words.enDefinition: the highest British degree class, typically seventy percent and above

examples.en: Getting first-class honours requires averaging seventy percent across your final modules.
examples.zh: 拿到「一等学位」需要毕业模块平均达到七十分。

examples.en: He celebrated earning first-class honours in economics at his graduation.
examples.zh: 毕业时他拿到了经济学「一等学位」，好好庆祝了一番。

words.enDefinition: the British degree class just below a first, called a 2:1

examples.en: Most graduate programs in the UK ask for upper second-class honours.
examples.zh: 英国大多数研究生项目要求申请者持有「二等一学位」。

examples.en: She missed first-class honours but still graduated with upper second-class honours.
examples.zh: 她与一等学位失之交臂，但仍以「二等一学位」毕业。

words.enDefinition: a master's result at the top grade band in Britain

examples.en: Master's students scoring over seventy percent achieve graduation with distinction.
examples.zh: 硕士成绩超过七十分就能「获优等学位」。

examples.en: He missed graduation with distinction by two marks on his dissertation.
examples.zh: 他因论文差了两分而未能「获优等学位」。

words.enDefinition: two full degree programs pursued at the same time

examples.en: He is enrolled in a double degree combining law and computer science.
examples.zh: 他正在修读法律与计算机科学的「双学位」。

examples.en: A double degree usually takes five years instead of four.
examples.zh: 「双学位」通常要读五年而不是四年。

words.enDefinition: one British degree combining two subjects in equal parts

examples.en: She studies French and politics as a joint honours degree.
examples.zh: 她修读的是法语与政治学的「联合荣誉学位」。

examples.en: Joint honours students split their modules evenly between the two subjects.
examples.zh: 「联合荣誉学位」的学生把模块课程平均分给两个科目。

words.enDefinition: a focused subject area inside your chosen major

examples.en: Her finance concentration requires four specialized courses in the junior year.
examples.zh: 她的金融「专业方向」要求大三修四门专门课程。

examples.en: Students declare a concentration at the end of sophomore year.
examples.zh: 学生在大二结束时确定「专业方向」。

words.enDefinition: a self-designed major drawing on several academic fields

examples.en: Her interdisciplinary major blends environmental science with public policy courses.
examples.zh: 她的「跨学科专业」把环境科学与公共政策课程结合在一起。

examples.en: The university approved his interdisciplinary major after a faculty review.
examples.zh: 经过教师委员会审核，学校批准了他的「跨学科专业」。

words.enDefinition: a student status before committing to a field

examples.en: Entering as an undeclared major gives you time to explore subjects.
examples.zh: 以「未定专业」入学让你有时间探索各个学科。

examples.en: About one in five freshmen starts college with an undeclared major.
examples.zh: 大约五分之一的新生入学时是「未定专业」。

words.enDefinition: finish your degree with honors noted on the record

examples.en: She managed to graduate with honors despite switching majors in sophomore year.
examples.zh: 尽管大二转了专业，她还是「以优异成绩毕业」。

examples.en: Students who graduate with honors wear a special cord at commencement.
examples.zh: 「以优异成绩毕业」的学生在典礼上会佩戴特殊的肩绳。

words.enDefinition: an award granted to distinguished guests rather than earned

examples.en: The commencement speaker received an honorary degree before addressing graduates.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼演讲嘉宾在致辞前获颁了「荣誉学位」。

examples.en: Universities confer an honorary degree on artists, scientists, and public leaders.
examples.zh: 大学会向艺术家、科学家和社会领袖授予「荣誉学位」。

words.enDefinition: the course credits you still need before graduating

examples.en: The degree audit shows I only have nine remaining credits.
examples.zh: 学位审核显示我只剩九个「剩余学分」了。

examples.en: She plans to spread her remaining credits across two final terms.
examples.zh: 她打算把「剩余学分」分摊到最后两个学期修完。

words.enDefinition: the final credits that must be earned at your university

examples.en: Transfer students must meet the residency requirement of thirty final credits.
examples.zh: 转学生必须满足最后三十学分在本校修读的「本校修读要求」。

examples.en: The advisor explained the residency requirement to our exchange group.
examples.zh: 导师向我们交换生小组解释了「本校修读要求」。

words.enDefinition: the minimum grade point average needed to graduate

examples.en: Students below the 2.0 GPA requirement cannot graduate this term.
examples.zh: 低于 2.0「绩点要求」的学生这学期无法毕业。

examples.en: Each program lists its own GPA requirement for the major.
examples.zh: 每个项目都会列出主修专业自己的「绩点要求」。

words.enDefinition: a report listing completed and outstanding degree requirements

examples.en: Run a degree progress report before meeting your advisor each term.
examples.zh: 每学期见导师前，先跑一份「学位进度报告」。

examples.en: The degree progress report flagged two elective courses I still need.
examples.zh: 「学位进度报告」标出了我还缺的两门选修课。

words.enDefinition: the edition of degree requirements your studies follow

examples.en: Your catalog year determines which degree requirements apply to you.
examples.zh: 你的「培养方案版本」决定适用哪一版学位要求。

examples.en: Switching your catalog year requires written approval from the registrar.
examples.zh: 更换「培养方案版本」需要注册办公室的书面批准。

words.enDefinition: a term-by-term course map leading to graduation

examples.en: My advisor updated my degree plan for the next four semesters.
examples.zh: 导师为我更新了今后四个学期的「学位规划」。

examples.en: A clear degree plan helps you avoid extra tuition fees.
examples.zh: 清晰的「学位规划」能帮你避免多交学费。

words.enDefinition: the term in which you plan to finish

examples.en: Please update your expected graduation date in the student portal.
examples.zh: 请在学生门户里更新你的「预计毕业日期」。

examples.en: My expected graduation date moved to December after I dropped a course.
examples.zh: 退掉一门课后，我的「预计毕业日期」推迟到了十二月。

words.enDefinition: the last date to file for graduation in a term

examples.en: Miss the graduation deadline and you must wait for the next term.
examples.zh: 错过「毕业申请截止日」，你就只能等下一学期了。

examples.en: The graduation deadline for fall candidates is the first Friday of September.
examples.zh: 秋季毕业候选人的「毕业申请截止日」是九月的第一个周五。

words.enDefinition: a student approved to receive a degree this term

examples.en: The registrar emailed every candidate for graduation about clearance tasks.
examples.zh: 注册办公室给每位「毕业候选人」发了关于核验事项的邮件。

examples.en: As a candidate for graduation, she must settle all library fines.
examples.zh: 作为「毕业候选人」，她必须结清所有图书馆罚款。

words.enDefinition: submit the formal request that your degree be conferred

examples.en: You must apply to graduate even after finishing all requirements.
examples.zh: 即使修完全部要求，你也必须「申请毕业」。

examples.en: Seniors apply to graduate through the registrar's online form each semester.
examples.zh: 毕业年级学生每学期通过注册办公室的在线表格「申请毕业」。

collocations: apply to graduate before the deadline

words.enDefinition: the official form asking the university to award your degree

examples.en: My graduation application was approved within two weeks of submission.
examples.zh: 我的「毕业申请」提交两周内就获批了。

examples.en: Check the status of your graduation application under student records.
examples.zh: 在学生档案栏目查看「毕业申请」的进度。

words.enDefinition: a graduation application filed after the deadline with an extra fee

examples.en: His late graduation application came with an extra fifty-dollar processing fee.
examples.zh: 他的「逾期毕业申请」多交了五十美元手续费。

examples.en: She filed a late graduation application after missing the March deadline.
examples.zh: 错过三月截止日后，她提交了「逾期毕业申请」。

words.enDefinition: the sign-offs confirming you are allowed to graduate

examples.en: Graduation clearance requires signatures from the library, housing, and your department.
examples.zh: 「毕业资格核验」需要图书馆、住宿部门和院系签字。

examples.en: My graduation clearance was held up by an unpaid lab fee.
examples.zh: 一笔未缴的实验费耽误了我的「毕业资格核验」。

words.enDefinition: a task list seniors finish before commencement day

examples.en: The graduation checklist includes the gown order, survey, and clearance form.
examples.zh: 「毕业事项清单」包括订袍服、填问卷和交核验表。

examples.en: Print the graduation checklist so you do not miss any deadlines.
examples.zh: 把「毕业事项清单」打印出来，免得漏掉截止日期。

words.enDefinition: a record block that prevents your graduation from processing

examples.en: An unpaid parking ticket placed a graduation hold on her account.
examples.zh: 一张未缴的停车罚单让她的账户被设置了「毕业冻结项」。

examples.en: Check for a graduation hold before your final term begins.
examples.zh: 最后一学期开始前，先查一下有没有「毕业冻结项」。

collocations: a graduation hold on your account

words.enDefinition: a block caused by unpaid tuition or other fees

examples.en: The bursar placed a financial hold on accounts with unpaid tuition.
examples.zh: 出纳处给欠缴学费的账户设置了「财务冻结」。

examples.en: A financial hold will stop your diploma from being mailed.
examples.zh: 「财务冻结」会导致你的证书无法邮寄。

collocations: a financial hold on your account

words.enDefinition: finishing requirements at the end of the summer term

examples.en: After one failed course, he chose summer graduation instead of spring.
examples.zh: 一门课挂掉后，他选择了「夏季毕业」而不是春季毕业。

examples.en: Summer graduation lets students walk at the following spring commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 选择「夏季毕业」的学生可以参加来年春季的学位授予典礼。

words.enDefinition: the one-time charge covering diploma processing and ceremonies

examples.en: The graduation fee covers diploma processing but not the gown.
examples.zh: 「毕业费用」包含证书制作，但不包含袍服。

examples.en: Pay the graduation fee at the same time as your application.
examples.zh: 「毕业费用」要和申请一起缴纳。

words.enDefinition: the formal ceremony at which degrees are officially conferred

examples.en: The commencement ceremony begins at nine sharp in the stadium.
examples.zh: 「学位授予典礼」九点整在体育场开始。

examples.en: Her whole family flew in to attend the commencement ceremony.
examples.zh: 她全家飞过来参加「学位授予典礼」。

words.enDefinition: the school event celebrating students who are finishing

examples.en: The graduation ceremony lasts about two hours, including speeches by graduates.
examples.zh: 「毕业典礼」包括毕业生致辞在内，大约持续两个小时。

examples.en: Photos after the graduation ceremony are taken on the main lawn.
examples.zh: 「毕业典礼」结束后大家在大草坪上拍照。

words.enDefinition: the invited guest who addresses graduates at commencement

examples.en: This year's commencement speaker is an alumna who founded a tech company.
examples.zh: 今年的「毕业典礼演讲嘉宾」是一位创办了科技公司的女校友。

examples.en: The commencement speaker told graduates to stay curious after campus.
examples.zh: 「毕业典礼演讲嘉宾」告诉毕业生们离开校园后要保持好奇。

words.enDefinition: the practice session for graduates before commencement day

examples.en: Attendance at graduation rehearsal is mandatory for all degree candidates.
examples.zh: 所有学位候选人都必须参加「毕业典礼彩排」。

examples.en: The graduation rehearsal takes place the afternoon before commencement day.
examples.zh: 「毕业典礼彩排」在典礼前一天下午举行。

words.enDefinition: take part in the ceremony procession and stage walk

examples.en: International students can walk at commencement even before finishing their last credits.
examples.zh: 国际学生即使还没修完最后学分，也可以「毕业走台」。

examples.en: He will walk at commencement in May and finish his thesis in July.
examples.zh: 他会参加五月的典礼「毕业走台」，七月再完成论文。

collocations: be eligible to walk at commencement

words.enDefinition: receive your degree without attending the ceremony in person

examples.en: Students abroad can graduate in absentia and receive diplomas by mail.
examples.zh: 在国外的学生可以「缺席毕业」，证书邮寄到家。

examples.en: She chose to graduate in absentia because her visa expired in June.
examples.zh: 因为签证六月到期，她选择了「缺席毕业」。

words.enDefinition: a springtime ceremony honoring high-achieving students before commencement

examples.en: The honors convocation awards medals to top seniors each April.
examples.zh: 每年四月，「荣誉表彰大会」会向优秀毕业生颁发奖章。

examples.en: She received a departmental book award at the honors convocation.
examples.zh: 她在「荣誉表彰大会」上获得了系里的图书奖。

words.enDefinition: a graduate ceremony where advisors place hoods on candidates

examples.en: At the hooding ceremony, her advisor placed the doctoral hood on her.
examples.zh: 在「学位披巾礼」上，导师为她披上了博士披巾。

examples.en: Each master's graduate is recognized individually during the hooding ceremony.
examples.zh: 「学位披巾礼」上每位硕士毕业生都会被逐一介绍。

words.enDefinition: the traditional cap and robe worn on graduation day

examples.en: Order your cap and gown before the March deadline or pay extra.
examples.zh: 在三月的截止日期前订好「学位帽袍」，否则要加钱。

examples.en: Graduates wear a cap and gown according to their degree level.
examples.zh: 毕业生按学位层次穿相应的「学位帽袍」。

words.enDefinition: the robe worn over your clothes during commencement

examples.en: Most bachelor's graduates here wear a simple black graduation gown.
examples.zh: 这里大多数本科毕业生穿一件朴素的黑色「毕业袍」。

examples.en: You wear the graduation gown over regular clothes at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典礼上「毕业袍」穿在平常的衣服外面。

words.enDefinition: borrowing regalia from the campus store for a fee

examples.en: Gown rental costs forty dollars and includes the cap and tassel.
examples.zh: 「袍服租借」四十美元，含学位帽和流苏。

examples.en: She picked up her gown rental order at the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 她在校园书店取了「袍服租借」的订单。

words.enDefinition: the flat square cap worn at graduation ceremonies

examples.en: Graduates tilt the mortarboard to the right after degrees are conferred.
examples.zh: 学位授予后，毕业生把「方形学位帽」拨向右边。

examples.en: She decorated her mortarboard with glitter and a thank-you message.
examples.zh: 她在「方形学位帽」上贴了亮片和感谢语。

words.enDefinition: the hanging cord ornament attached to a graduation cap

examples.en: The tassel hangs on the right side until degrees are awarded.
examples.zh: 学位授予之前，「流苏」一直垂在帽子右侧。

examples.en: Many graduates keep their tassel as a souvenir after the ceremony.
examples.zh: 很多毕业生典礼后把「流苏」留作纪念。

words.enDefinition: move the cap tassel from one side to the other

examples.en: Graduates turn the tassel from right to left after receiving degrees.
examples.zh: 毕业生领学位后把「流苏」从右拨到左。

examples.en: The dean asked everyone to turn the tassel together at the end.
examples.zh: 院长请大家最后一起「拨流苏」。

collocations: turn the tassel to the left
ask graduates to turn the tassel

words.enDefinition: throwing caps into the air when the ceremony ends

examples.en: The cap toss on the quad is the favorite photo moment.
examples.zh: 大草坪上的「抛帽」是最受欢迎的拍照环节。

examples.en: Save the cap toss until the official closing of the ceremony.
examples.zh: 「抛帽」要留到典礼正式结束时再进行。

words.enDefinition: a colored cord worn at commencement to mark honors

examples.en: Honor society members receive a gold honor cord for commencement.
examples.zh: 荣誉学会成员会拿到一条金色「荣誉肩带」在典礼上佩戴。

examples.en: She wore her honor cord along with the graduation stole.
examples.zh: 她同时佩戴了「荣誉肩带」和毕业披带。

words.enDefinition: a decorative cloth band worn over the gown

examples.en: Her graduation stole represents four years in the Chinese student association.
examples.zh: 她的「毕业披带」代表她在中国学生会待了四年。

examples.en: Some departments embroider the school crest on each graduation stole.
examples.zh: 有些院系会在「毕业披带」上绣校徽。

words.enDefinition: the formal caps, gowns, and hoods used at ceremonies

examples.en: Faculty members in full academic regalia lead the commencement procession.
examples.zh: 身穿全套「学位礼服」的教师们走在典礼队伍最前面。

examples.en: Doctoral academic regalia includes a colored hood and velvet bars.
examples.zh: 博士「学位礼服」带有彩色披巾和天鹅绒饰条。

words.enDefinition: the printed booklet listing graduates and ceremony order

examples.en: Your name appears in the commencement program exactly as filed.
examples.zh: 「毕业典礼手册」上的名字与你登记的完全一致。

examples.en: Check the commencement program for the processional order and speaker times.
examples.zh: 在「毕业典礼手册」里查看入场顺序和嘉宾致辞时间。

words.enDefinition: tickets for family and friends attending the ceremony

examples.en: Each graduate receives four guest tickets for the stadium ceremony.
examples.zh: 每位毕业生拿到四张体育场典礼的「观礼门票」。

examples.en: Extra guest tickets are released on a first-come basis in April.
examples.zh: 额外的「观礼门票」四月先到先得。

words.enDefinition: cards sent to relatives to announce your graduation

examples.en: She mailed graduation announcements to relatives back home in Chengdu.
examples.zh: 她给成都老家的亲戚寄了「毕业喜报卡片」。

examples.en: Graduation announcements usually include the degree, date, and ceremony venue.
examples.zh: 「毕业喜报卡片」通常写明学位、日期和典礼地点。

words.enDefinition: a celebration with friends and family after commencement

examples.en: Roommates are throwing a graduation party on the rooftop Saturday evening.
examples.zh: 室友们周六晚上在天台办「毕业派对」。

examples.en: Her parents hosted a graduation party for relatives and classmates.
examples.zh: 她父母为亲戚和同学办了一场「毕业派对」。

words.enDefinition: the top student who gives the farewell speech

examples.en: The valedictorian closed the ceremony with a heartfelt farewell speech.
examples.zh: 「毕业生代表」以一段深情的告别演讲为典礼收尾。

examples.en: Being named valedictorian requires the highest GPA in the class.
examples.zh: 被评为「毕业生代表」需要全年级最高的绩点。

words.enDefinition: a ring bearing the school crest, bought near graduation

examples.en: He ordered a class ring with his major engraved inside.
examples.zh: 他订了一枚内圈刻着专业的「毕业纪念戒指」。

examples.en: Class ring orders are taken in the student union every spring.
examples.zh: 「毕业纪念戒指」每年春季在学生活动中心接受订购。

words.enDefinition: a week of celebration events for graduating seniors

examples.en: Senior week includes a boat cruise, barbecues, and the yearbook signing.
examples.zh: 「毕业生周」包括游船、烧烤和纪念册签名活动。

examples.en: Buy senior week passes early because events sell out fast.
examples.zh: 「毕业生周」的通行证要早点买，活动很快售罄。

words.enDefinition: a present given to celebrate someone finishing their degree

examples.en: Her parents gave her a laptop as a graduation gift.
examples.zh: 父母送了她一台笔记本电脑作为「毕业礼物」。

examples.en: We chipped in for a watch as the graduation gift.
examples.zh: 我们凑钱买了块手表当「毕业礼物」。

words.enDefinition: portrait photos taken in regalia around graduation time

examples.en: We booked a photographer for graduation photos on the main quad.
examples.zh: 我们约了摄影师在大草坪拍「毕业照」。

examples.en: Graduation photos in front of the old library are a tradition.
examples.zh: 在老图书馆前拍「毕业照」是个传统。

words.enDefinition: the official document certifying that you completed the degree

examples.en: The diploma arrives by mail about eight weeks after commencement.
examples.zh: 「毕业证书」大约在典礼八周后邮寄到家。

examples.en: Frame your diploma and hang it above your desk at home.
examples.zh: 把「毕业证书」装进框里，挂在家中书桌上方。

words.enDefinition: the printed certificate itself, distinct from the qualification earned

examples.en: Some countries ask for a degree certificate plus an apostilled transcript.
examples.zh: 有些国家要求提供「学位证书」加海牙认证的成绩单。

examples.en: Your degree certificate and final transcript are issued separately by the registry.
examples.zh: 「学位证书」和最终成绩单由注册处分别签发。

words.enDefinition: the padded folder handed to graduates on stage

examples.en: You receive an empty diploma cover on stage, not the actual diploma.
examples.zh: 台上领到的只是空的「证书封套」，并非证书本体。

examples.en: The diploma cover is embossed with the university crest in gold.
examples.zh: 「证书封套」上烫金压印着校徽。

collocations: diploma cover with the university crest

words.enDefinition: collecting your diploma in person from the registrar

examples.en: Diploma pickup is available at the service counter from June onward.
examples.zh: 六月起可以到服务柜台办理「证书自取」。

examples.en: Bring photo ID for diploma pickup, or authorize someone in writing.
examples.zh: 「证书自取」要带带照片的证件，或书面委托他人。

words.enDefinition: having the university post your diploma to an address

examples.en: Diploma mailing to China can take up to eight weeks.
examples.zh: 「证书邮寄」到中国可能需要长达八周。

examples.en: Update your diploma mailing address before you leave campus housing.
examples.zh: 搬出校内宿舍前，更新你的「证书邮寄」地址。

words.enDefinition: ordering a new diploma after the original is lost

examples.en: Diploma replacement costs fifty dollars and takes four to six weeks.
examples.zh: 「证书补办」收费五十美元，需要四到六周。

examples.en: She requested a diploma replacement after hers was damaged in a move.
examples.zh: 搬家时证书损坏后，她申请了「证书补办」。

words.enDefinition: a special frame for displaying your diploma on a wall

examples.en: The campus bookstore sells a diploma frame engraved with the seal.
examples.zh: 校园书店卖刻有校徽的「证书相框」。

examples.en: He bought a walnut diploma frame before his parents visited.
examples.zh: 父母来访前，他买了一个胡桃木「证书相框」。

words.enDefinition: the version of your name printed on the diploma

examples.en: Submit your diploma name before the registrar's deadline in early March.
examples.zh: 在三月初的截止日前提交你的「证书姓名」。

examples.en: Her diploma name includes her full Chinese name in pinyin.
examples.zh: 她的「证书姓名」是她中文姓名的完整拼音。

words.enDefinition: an official confirmation that your degree was really awarded

examples.en: Employers use the degree verification service to confirm your credentials.
examples.zh: 雇主通过「学位核实」服务确认你的学历真伪。

examples.en: You can order degree verification online through the registrar's portal.
examples.zh: 你可以在注册处门户在线申请「学位核实」。

words.enDefinition: the degree being added to your official academic record

examples.en: Degree posting happens about four weeks after the conferral date.
examples.zh: 「学位入档」大约在授予日期四周后完成。

examples.en: Your transcript shows the degree posting once grades are finalized.
examples.zh: 成绩定档后，成绩单上就会出现「学位入档」记录。

words.enDefinition: a temporary letter proving completion before the diploma arrives

examples.en: International students request a letter of completion for visa purposes.
examples.zh: 国际学生为办签证申请「结业证明信」。

examples.en: The letter of completion states my degree and conferral date.
examples.zh: 「结业证明信」上写明了我的学位和授予日期。

collocations: a letter of completion for your visa

words.enDefinition: a certified transcript sealed and signed by the registrar

examples.en: Graduate schools require an official transcript in a sealed envelope.
examples.zh: 研究生院要求提交密封信封里的「官方成绩单」。

examples.en: Order an official transcript online and pay the five-dollar fee.
examples.zh: 在线订购「官方成绩单」并支付五美元费用。

collocations: official transcript in a sealed envelope

words.enDefinition: the ordering process for copies of your academic record

examples.en: Submit a transcript request online and allow three business days.
examples.zh: 在线提交「成绩单申请」，并预留三个工作日。

examples.en: Her transcript request was delayed because of an old library fine.
examples.zh: 一笔旧的图书馆罚款耽误了她的「成绩单申请」。

words.enDefinition: a transcript inside an unopened envelope stamped by the registrar

examples.en: Keep the sealed transcript unopened or universities will reject it.
examples.zh: 「密封成绩单」不要拆封，否则学校会拒收。

examples.en: Bring one sealed transcript to the scholarship interview on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五的奖学金面试要带一份「密封成绩单」。

words.enDefinition: a transcript delivered securely by email or a document network

examples.en: The electronic transcript arrived at the admissions office within an hour.
examples.zh: 「电子成绩单」一小时内就送达了招生办公室。

examples.en: Most graduate programs now accept an electronic transcript instead of paper.
examples.zh: 大多数研究生项目现在接受「电子成绩单」替代纸质版。

words.enDefinition: the transcript issued after final grades and degree posting

examples.en: Graduate admissions ask for your final transcript showing the degree awarded.
examples.zh: 研究生招生要求提交注明已授学位的「最终成绩单」。

examples.en: The final transcript is ready two weeks after degree posting.
examples.zh: 「最终成绩单」在学位入档两周后就能开出。

words.enDefinition: a block preventing transcript release until issues are resolved

examples.en: There is a transcript hold on my account from an unpaid fee.
examples.zh: 因为一笔未缴费用，我的账户被设了「成绩单冻结」。

examples.en: The registrar lifted the transcript hold once the fine was settled.
examples.zh: 罚款结清后，注册处解除了「成绩单冻结」。

collocations: a transcript hold for unpaid fees

words.enDefinition: a questionnaire about post-graduation plans required for clearance

examples.en: Complete the graduation survey so the career office can track outcomes.
examples.zh: 填完「毕业生调查」，就业指导办公室才能统计去向。

examples.en: The graduation survey takes ten minutes and is required for clearance.
examples.zh: 「毕业生调查」只需十分钟，却是核验的必办项。

words.enDefinition: the official act by which the university awards degrees

examples.en: Degree conferral happens in May, August, and December each year.
examples.zh: 每年五月、八月和十二月进行「学位授予」。

examples.en: Your diploma is printed only after the official degree conferral.
examples.zh: 证书只有在正式「学位授予」之后才会印制。

words.enDefinition: the official calendar date your degree takes effect

examples.en: The conferral date appears on both the diploma and the transcript.
examples.zh: 「授予日期」会同时出现在证书和成绩单上。

examples.en: Her conferral date is August fifteenth even though ceremonies ended in May.
examples.zh: 虽然典礼五月就结束了，她的「授予日期」是八月十五日。

words.enDefinition: the status shown once the university grants the degree

examples.en: The registrar's website shows degree awarded within a week of conferral.
examples.zh: 注册处网站会在授予后一周内显示「已授学位」。

examples.en: Employers verify the degree awarded date through the national database.
examples.zh: 雇主通过全国数据库核实「已授学位」的日期。

words.enDefinition: a final project that applies everything learned in the major

examples.en: Her capstone project pairs engineering students with a local hospital.
examples.zh: 她的「毕业综合项目」让工科学生与本地医院结对合作。

examples.en: The capstone project replaces the thesis for most applied majors.
examples.zh: 对大多数应用型专业来说，「毕业综合项目」可替代论文。

words.enDefinition: a long research paper written during the final year

examples.en: Writing a senior thesis takes two semesters of independent research.
examples.zh: 写「毕业论文」需要两个学期的独立研究。

examples.en: Her senior thesis on urban birds won the department prize.
examples.zh: 她关于城市鸟类的「毕业论文」获得了系里的大奖。

collocations: a senior thesis on urban ecology

words.enDefinition: the research paper required by many master's programs

examples.en: Defending your master's thesis usually takes about ninety minutes in total.
examples.zh: 「硕士论文」答辩通常总共约九十分钟。

examples.en: His master's thesis compared commuting patterns in three Asian cities.
examples.zh: 他的「硕士论文」比较了三个亚洲城市的通勤模式。

words.enDefinition: the research plan approved before thesis work begins

examples.en: The committee approved her thesis proposal with two minor revisions.
examples.zh: 委员会批准了她的「论文开题报告」，只需两处小修改。

examples.en: A strong thesis proposal defines the question, methods, and timeline.
examples.zh: 一份好的「论文开题报告」要界定问题、方法和时间表。

words.enDefinition: the professor who supervises your thesis from start to finish

examples.en: My thesis advisor meets with me every other Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 「论文导师」每隔一周的周四下午与我见面。

examples.en: Choose a thesis advisor whose research matches your topic closely.
examples.zh: 选择研究方向与你课题高度契合的「论文导师」。

words.enDefinition: handing in the finished thesis by the official deadline

examples.en: Online thesis submission opens two weeks before the spring deadline.
examples.zh: 在线「论文提交」在春季截止日期前两周开放。

examples.en: Late thesis submission requires a petition to the graduate school.
examples.zh: 逾期「论文提交」需要向研究生院提交申请。

words.enDefinition: the final date for submitting your completed thesis

examples.en: The thesis deadline for spring graduation this year is April tenth.
examples.zh: 今年春季毕业的「论文截止日期」是四月十日。

examples.en: She requested an extension two days before the thesis deadline.
examples.zh: 她在「论文截止日期」前两天申请了延期。

words.enDefinition: the oral examination where a committee questions your thesis

examples.en: Her thesis defense is scheduled for the first Friday of May.
examples.zh: 她的「论文答辩」安排在五月第一个周五。

examples.en: During the thesis defense, the committee asked about her sampling method.
examples.zh: 「论文答辩」中，委员会追问了她的抽样方法。

words.enDefinition: the spoken question-and-answer part of thesis approval

examples.en: The oral defense lasts ninety minutes and is open to classmates.
examples.zh: 「口头答辩」九十分钟，对本班同学开放旁听。

examples.en: Nervous candidates should rehearse their oral defense with friends first.
examples.zh: 容易紧张的考生应该先和朋友演练「口头答辩」。

words.enDefinition: the scheduled day of your thesis or dissertation defense

examples.en: The defense date must be announced at least two weeks ahead.
examples.zh: 「答辩日期」必须至少提前两周公布。

examples.en: We pushed the defense date back a week after revisions.
examples.zh: 修改之后，我们把「答辩日期」推迟了一周。

words.enDefinition: the British oral examination defending a doctoral thesis

examples.en: Her viva lasted three hours with two external examiners present.
examples.zh: 她的「博士口试答辩」进行了三个小时，两位校外评审在场。

examples.en: He spent the summer preparing for his viva in chemistry.
examples.zh: 他整个夏天都在准备化学「博士口试答辩」。

words.enDefinition: small required revisions after a viva, completed within weeks

examples.en: The examiners passed her thesis with minor corrections to two chapters.
examples.zh: 评审通过她的论文，只需对两章做「少量修改」。

examples.en: Minor corrections must be uploaded within three months of the viva.
examples.zh: 「少量修改」须在口试答辩后三个月内上传。

words.enDefinition: the extended research work written for a doctorate

examples.en: Her dissertation analyzes groundwater quality across three farming regions in Kenya.
examples.zh: 她的「博士论文」分析了肯尼亚三个农业区的地下水水质。

examples.en: He finally defended his dissertation after four years of fieldwork.
examples.zh: 四年田野工作之后，他终于完成了「博士论文」答辩。

words.enDefinition: the doctoral research plan defended before fieldwork begins

examples.en: Her dissertation proposal passed at the second committee review meeting.
examples.zh: 她的「博士论文开题」在委员会第二次审核时通过。

examples.en: A clear dissertation proposal saves you a year of wasted fieldwork.
examples.zh: 清晰的「博士论文开题」能帮你省去一年无效的田野工作。

words.enDefinition: the group of professors supervising and examining a dissertation

examples.en: Her dissertation committee includes two professors from another university in Canada.
examples.zh: 她的「博士论文委员会」里有两位来自加拿大另一所大学的教授。

examples.en: Form your dissertation committee before the end of your first year.
examples.zh: 要在第一学年结束前组成你的「博士论文委员会」。

words.enDefinition: the professor who leads your thesis or dissertation committee

examples.en: The committee chair signs off on every milestone before the defense.
examples.zh: 答辩前每个节点都要由「委员会主席」签字确认。

examples.en: Email the committee chair to book your proposal meeting next month.
examples.zh: 发邮件给「委员会主席」，预约下个月的开题会议。

words.enDefinition: an outside professor who fairly examines your thesis

examples.en: The external examiner flew in from Toronto for the defense.
examples.zh: 「校外评审」从多伦多飞来参加答辩。

examples.en: An external examiner helps keep grading standards consistent across universities.
examples.zh: 「校外评审」有助于保持各大学评分标准一致。

collocations: an external examiner at the viva

words.enDefinition: a delay on public release of a thesis, often for patents

examples.en: A one-year thesis embargo protects the team's pending patent application.
examples.zh: 一年的「论文保密期」可以保护团队待批的专利申请。

examples.en: She placed her thesis embargo so journals could publish first.
examples.zh: 她设置了「论文保密期」，好让期刊先行发表。

words.enDefinition: the university branch offering master's and doctoral study

examples.en: She is applying to graduate school for the fall 2027 intake.
examples.zh: 她正在申请2027年秋季入学的「研究生院」。

examples.en: Graduate school applications ask for transcripts, references, and a purpose statement.
examples.zh: 「研究生院」申请需要成绩单、推荐信和目的陈述。

words.enDefinition: a specific master's or PhD course of study

examples.en: Their graduate program in biostatistics admits only twenty students yearly.
examples.zh: 他们的生物统计「研究生项目」每年只录取二十人。

examples.en: Ask the graduate program coordinator about funding for international students.
examples.zh: 向「研究生项目」协调员询问国际学生的资助情况。

words.enDefinition: study undertaken after a bachelor's degree, such as a master's

examples.en: He chose postgraduate study in the UK for its one-year master's.
examples.zh: 因为一年制硕士，他选择了在英国进行「研究生学习」。

examples.en: Postgraduate study requires early planning of funding, housing, and visas.
examples.zh: 「研究生学习」需要尽早规划经费、住宿和签证。

words.enDefinition: the document set submitted to enter a graduate program

examples.en: My graduate application includes transcripts, two references, and a writing sample.
examples.zh: 我的「研究生申请」包括成绩单、两封推荐信和一份写作样本。

examples.en: I tracked every graduate application deadline in one shared spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我用一个共享表格跟踪每份「研究生申请」的截止日期。

words.enDefinition: an official letter admitting you to a program

examples.en: She received an offer of admission from the engineering faculty.
examples.zh: 她收到了工学院的「录取通知」。

examples.en: You must accept the offer of admission before the reply deadline.
examples.zh: 必须在答复截止日期前接受「录取通知」。

words.enDefinition: admission granted only if you later meet stated conditions

examples.en: The conditional offer becomes final once my final transcript arrives.
examples.zh: 等我的最终成绩单寄到，「有条件录取」就转为正式录取。

examples.en: Her conditional offer requires an overall IELTS band of seven.
examples.zh: 她的「有条件录取」要求雅思总分七分。

words.enDefinition: a letter written by a professor supporting your application

examples.en: Ask for each reference letter at least three weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 每封「推荐信」都要至少提前三周去请。

examples.en: A strong reference letter mentions specific projects from your seminars.
examples.zh: 一封有力的「推荐信」会提到你研讨课上的具体项目。

words.enDefinition: the message asking a professor to write a reference

examples.en: Send your reference request with your CV and draft statement.
examples.zh: 发「推荐信请求」时附上简历和陈述草稿。

examples.en: A polite reference request gives professors time to write well.
examples.zh: 礼貌的「推荐信请求」能给教授留出写好推荐信的时间。

collocations: follow up on a reference request

words.enDefinition: a professor or lecturer who provides your academic reference

examples.en: List two academic referees on your postgraduate application form for this program.
examples.zh: 在该项目的研究生申请表上填写两位「学术推荐人」。

examples.en: Email your academic referee the exact deadline and submission link.
examples.zh: 把确切的截止日期和提交链接发给你「学术推荐人」。

words.enDefinition: an essay explaining your goals for graduate study

examples.en: Draft your statement of purpose early and revise it with a tutor.
examples.zh: 尽早起草「目的陈述」，并请辅导老师修改。

examples.en: The statement of purpose should connect your coursework to future research.
examples.zh: 「目的陈述」要把你的课程学习与未来研究联系起来。

words.enDefinition: an essay describing your background, interests, and motivations

examples.en: Her personal statement opened with a story from her internship.
examples.zh: 她的「个人陈述」以一段实习经历开篇。

examples.en: Keep the personal statement under five thousand characters for UCAS.
examples.zh: 申请 UCAS 时「个人陈述」要控制在五千字符以内。

words.enDefinition: an academic paper submitted as proof of research writing ability

examples.en: The program asks for a writing sample of fifteen pages.
examples.zh: 该项目要求提交十五页的「写作样本」。

examples.en: He submitted an edited seminar paper as his writing sample.
examples.zh: 他提交了一篇修改过的研讨课论文作为「写作样本」。

words.enDefinition: a service converting foreign academic records into local equivalents

examples.en: Her credential evaluation from WES took about four business weeks.
examples.zh: 她在 WES 的「学历认证评估」花了大约四个工作周。

examples.en: A credential evaluation converts Chinese grades into a US GPA.
examples.zh: 「学历认证评估」会把中国成绩换算成美国的绩点。

words.enDefinition: a student in the last year of a degree program

examples.en: As a final-year student, she books weekly meetings with her advisor.
examples.zh: 作为「毕业班学生」，她每周预约一次导师面谈。

examples.en: Final-year students get first pick of thesis advisors in October.
examples.zh: 「毕业班学生」十月可优先挑选论文导师。

words.enDefinition: a final-year undergraduate about to receive a degree

examples.en: Graduating seniors must file the graduation application by October first.
examples.zh: 「应届毕业生」必须在十月一日前提交毕业申请。

examples.en: Every graduating senior receives two guest tickets for the ceremony by default.
examples.zh: 每位「应届毕业生」默认获得两张典礼的观礼门票。

words.enDefinition: all students completing their degrees in the same year

examples.en: The graduating class of 2027 chose blue tassels for commencement.
examples.zh: 2027届的「同届毕业生」为毕业典礼挑选了蓝色流苏。

examples.en: She was voted speaker for her graduating class at rehearsal.
examples.zh: 彩排时她被推选为「同届毕业生」的致辞代表。
